title: End of the page: freeze the fading section's shimmer (rev 2: the flat cover is dropped)
problem:
Rev 2 answers your note on rev 1, point by point.

1. "(b) has a bug: the background fades out sometimes at Serious." I could not find the cause in our data:
- No phone recording of (b) exists. Today's phone block (P-155) tested three other builds, and you were the only one to see (b) on the phone.
- Chrome check: the page height changed mid-fade, the way the Safari toolbar changes it. The cover still filled the screen exactly, and its fade matched today's fade at all 16 checks.
- So it is unknown whether the cover itself or the fade timing caused what you saw.

2. So (b) is dropped instead of guessing a fix. (a) stays, and is now the only option.

3. You asked to try arch-compositor-morph's change first. It is the top priority now and is on the phone today.
- It moves the end panel, the nav and the page's dark layer off the main work, but it leaves this section's fade alone.
- So (a) adds to it: (a)'s change applies to that build without a single edit (checked).

Background from rev 1:
- At the end of the page the big end panel grows over the last section (the four feature rows).
- Over the first 55 % of that growth the section fades out: blurrier (up to 12 px) and more transparent, until it is invisible.
- Meanwhile 5 endless shimmers keep running in it: 3 colour sweeps over the row titles and 2 glints on the Payment picture (Chrome counts, OBSERVED).
- Pausing them once the section is fully invisible needs no decision: it changes no pixel, and it goes into the next build by itself.
idea:
(a) freezes the 5 shimmers from the first moment of the fade.
- The 3 title sweeps and 2 glints stop where they are when the fade starts.
- The blur and the fade stay exactly as today.
- Scroll back up and they continue from where they stopped.

In Try-it, A is today's best build (v9-final) and B is v9-final plus (a).
looksSame:
The blur, the fade, the panel and every colour are unchanged.
- Only the shimmers stop moving while the section fades.
- Most of that time the section is already blurred and half transparent.
visualDiff:
Still frames: no difference, 0 px² at every position.
- Chrome at phone size (430x775), 18 positions through the end morph, compared like for like (your pixel rule, PR-010: at most 0.5 % of the screen may differ).
The change is in motion only: the colour sweeps and glints stop moving during the fade. A still-frame check can't see that, so please judge it in Try-it.

gain.what: Shimmers running while the section fades
gain.how: Chrome page probe at phone size (430x932), counts only, at 45 % of the fade. Not a timing test.

risk:
(a) has no phone timing number yet, and the gain may be too small to see.
- The counts come from Chrome, which can't show the phone's graphics work.
- The suggested order: arch-compositor-morph's change first, as you asked. (a) would then get one short phone check on top of it.
- If you prefer to stop here, decline: the shimmers still pause once the section is invisible.

shots.caption: Fade half done (430x775), still frame: identical. The change is motion only (shimmers stop).
